Elevate case handling

Our Stretch robot offers predictability for warehouse operations, working continuously and keeping the flow of goods moving. With the ability to move hundreds of cases an hour, Stretch ensures that daily goals are met even as order fulfillment demands soar.

Discover Stretch

Mobility and manipulation for the warehouse

Mobile case handling with Stretch is unlocking new opportunities to automate dull, dirty, and dangerous warehousing tasks, freeing your team up to do more.

Fast to Deploy
Works Continuously
Flexible

Automation without heavy infrastructure

Stop overhauling your site to accommodate automation. Stretch integrates seamlessly, and is designed to handle cases with efficiency and speed. With a straightforward installation and setup process, our robot can easily supplement your labor resources to keep the flow of goods moving.

Fast to Deploy
Fast to Deploy
Works Continuously
Flexible
Fast to Deploy

Stretch is ready to implement and is up and running in just days from delivery, working within existing warehouse infrastructure. We offering comprehensive training and resources to help your team learn to safely and efficiently operate Stretch. Since the robot makes all decisions in real time, no pre-programming is required before putting Stretch to work.

 

Works Continuously

Long battery life powers Stretch through single or multiple shifts any time of day or night. The robot’s advanced behaviors enable it to react in real time, even detecting and automatically retrieving any boxes that shift and fall while unloading, so Stretch can keep going without operator intervention.

Flexible

Stretch can handle a wide range of package types and sizes, from standard brown to highly graphical, up to 50 pounds. The robot can handle typical container conditions, working its way through neat or messy box configurations alike.

Applications

Trailer Unloading

For unloading trailers and containers, let Stretch do the heavy lifting.
